Raven 68060
Hardware and software binary release

261020:

  rom:
	- motorola fpsp related bugfixes
	- general vector/interrupt performance increase
	- general ISA-Mem performance increase
	- grayscale bootlogo insted of 1bpp mono
	- added dsp info to bios setup screen
	- added fan controls to bios setup screen
	- added rgb controls to bios setup screen (Rev.A2)

  rvnova:
    - general ISA-Mem performance increase

  software:
    - includes updated MagiC binaries for snapshots at
	  https://tho-otto.m68k.eu/snapshots/magicmac/
	- moved software/raven/fpemu -> software/tools/fpu_emu/
	- moved software/raven/ymodem -> software/tools/ymodem/
    - added FAT32 filesystem driver for singletasking TOS
	  (software/tools/fat32)
